## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature / vibe (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring / internal cleanup

## How Has This Been Tested?
- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] `ruff check .` clean
- [ ] Manual testing in real git repo (interactive + quick mode)
- [ ] Tested on: macOS / Linux / Windows

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review
- [ ] I have commented my code where needed (especially detection logic)
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to documentation
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes
